title: feat(console): tell the comment author, in one sentence, which mentioned users will not be notified; draw picked mentions as chips
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoPzeJHeDfhpMWRZ877JUwQh)_

Fixes #28218
Refs #27703

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `ObjectStackAdapter.create` gains an optional third parameter `opts.onMentionsWithheld`, and `.update`'s existing `opts` gains the same optional member; both still resolve the record, and no export, key or route is added)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在记录讨论里 @ 了一个看不到这条记录的同事时，评论照常发出，同时弹出一句提示：「Grace Hopper、Linus 不会收到这条评论的通知。」发评论、回复、编辑时新加 @ 三处都会提示；不说原因，没有被拦下的人就不提示。输入框下方把已 @ 的人显示为标签，预览里的 @姓名 也显示为标签。
- 为什么改：按 #27703 裁决 A（「27703 同意」），服务端已在 #28174 把被拦下的人的 id 回给作者本人的写入答复（`withheldMentions`），但控制台一直不读，作者以为对方已被通知。
- 风险与回滚：数据适配器的 `create` / `update` 多了一个可选的逐次回调，返回值不变，其他调用方不受影响；回调抛错不会让已保存的评论被当成失败。回滚即 revert 本 PR，服务端不受影响。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（`tellMentionsWithheld` 与三个评论写回调）；`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`（`notifyWithheldMentions`）；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RichTextCommentInput.tsx`（标签行与预览）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.withheldMentions-28218.test.tsx packages/data-objectstack/src/withheldMentions-28218.test.ts packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RichTextCommentInput.mentionChips-28218.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件、14 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The answer reaches the caller** (`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`). Measured first: `ObjectStackAdapter.create` / `.update` resolved `result.record` and dropped every other member of the write answer, so `withheldMentions` never reached the record page. Both methods now take an optional per-call listener, `opts.onMentionsWithheld(ids)` (on `update` beside `ifMatch`, which still reaches the client alone). A module helper, `notifyWithheldMentions`, reads the answer structurally, keeps the string ids, and calls the listener once after the write succeeded, only when at least one id is named. A runtime that predates the key, or a write that withheld nobody, calls nothing. A throwing listener is isolated like the subscriber fan-outs, so a stored comment is never reported as failed. What every caller resolves is unchanged. A per-call listener was chosen over the global `onWriteWarning` channel because the sentence needs the picker's names, which only the writing page holds.

**One sentence, no reason** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`). `tellMentionsWithheld` maps the ids to names through the mention picker's suggestions (the list the write's `mentions` were extracted from) and raises one `toast.warning`: `detail.mentionsWithheld`, "NAMES will not be notified of this comment.", the names joined with the pack's `validation.formInvalidJoiner`, the list punctuation the record feed already uses. The three `sys_comment` writes pass it: `handleAddComment`, `handleAddReply` and `handleEditComment`. Per the ruling the sentence gives no reason (one bit per named user), and nothing probes a colleague's access before the write (B was not taken).

**Mention chips** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RichTextCommentInput.tsx`). Under the editor, the users the text mentions are a list of chips labelled `detail.mentionedPeople`, resolved with the same `extractMentions` the write uses, so the row shows exactly whom the comment's `mentions` will carry, multi-word names whole. In the preview, each picked `@NAME` is one chip (longest name first, not followed by a letter or digit, as `extractMentions` matches); any other `@word` keeps the plain highlight it had. The preview escapes the text before any markup, chips included.

**Copy.** `detail.mentionsWithheld` and `detail.mentionedPeople` in all ten packs. The sentence is phrased so it needs no plural forms in any pack. `detail.mentionedPeople` is also in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` (the provider-less mirror of the `en` pack).

**File surface.** Within the order's list: `RecordDetailView.tsx` (the three callbacks and one helper), `RichTextCommentInput.tsx`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, the ten packs, tests and the root changeset. Outside it, both small: `plugin-detail/src/useDetailTranslation.ts` (one row, the chip row's label, which the defaults-mirror test requires beside the pack) and `ui/packages/data-objectstack/README.md` (the method list names the new option, per `ui/AGENTS.md` #2). No `packages/spec/**` and no server change.

**Serial constraints.** Neither #28116 nor #27713 has landed (both open at the time of writing); this branch is on `main` `86cf7cef`. The edits in `RecordDetailView.tsx` are the helper and three call sites, in hunks neither PR touches as far as a read of their descriptions shows; whichever lands first, this branch merges `origin/main` and resolves.

## Tests

New:

- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/withheldMentions-28218.test.ts` (4): `create` hands the ids to the listener once and still resolves the plain record, and the listener is never forwarded to the client; `update` hands them on and `ifMatch` still reaches the client alone (no options bag without it); CONTROL: an answer without the key, with an empty list, or with no string ids calls nothing; a write without the listener resolves as before, and a throwing listener does not reject a stored write.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.withheldMentions-28218.test.tsx` (5), through the real `RecordDetailView`, its composer, reply input and edit form, under a real `I18nProvider` with the `en` pack read by key: a comment names the withheld users by their picker names (a multi-word name included) and is posted; only the withheld users are named; CONTROL: a comment whose mentions all reach their users says nothing; a reply names them; an edit that adds a mention names them.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RichTextCommentInput.mentionChips-28218.test.tsx` (5): the chip row names each picked user once, multi-word names whole; it follows the text and is absent with no mention; a prefix of a longer name or an `@word` naming nobody is no chip; the preview draws a picked `@NAME` as one chip and keeps other `@word`s plain; the preview escapes the text.

Updated: three assertions that pinned the `sys_comment` create's exact arguments now include the per-call listener (`commentWriteFailure-10899` ×2, `feedRecordScope`). Their behaviour is unchanged.

**Ablations** (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proved on disk, restored to the HEAD blob):

- `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the comment write without `onMentionsWithheld` → `RecordDetailView.withheldMentions-28218` 2 failed / 3 passed (the two comment cases); restored, blob `6cf08c0a` = HEAD.
- `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`, `notifyWithheldMentions` not calling the listener → `withheldMentions-28218` 3 failed / 1 passed (the control stays green, as it should); restored, blob `20fba8d2` = HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live, on a stock stack** (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, showcase, at this branch's build, 2026-10-30T20:11Z). As the seeded admin, a user created through `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user` with no membership (`membershipCreated: false`) cannot read the org's records. `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment` on a `showcase_project` record mentioning that user and `usr_showcase_auditor_demo` answered `withheldMentions` with both ids; a comment with no mentions answered no such key (`id`, `object`, `record` only); a `PATCH` adding the user to a comment that had no mention answered `withheldMentions` with that id. Through the real `ObjectStackAdapter` (built `dist`) and `@objectstack/client` against the same server: `create` with the listener heard `[that id]` and resolved the record without the key; an `update` that added no mention heard nothing. The server was stopped after the measure.
- The mention chips are drawn in the composer and its preview, as the ruling names. A posted comment's body in the feed is rendered by the timeline, not by this file, and is unchanged here.
- The sentence is a `toast.warning` after a successful write: the comment is posted, so it is not an error.
